scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n BACKEND,ADMIN,SHOP -c blue,magenta,green "cd my-shop-api && npm run dev" "npm run dev --prefix my-shop-admin" "cd my-shop-shop && npm run dev"
scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix my-shop-api && npm install --prefix my-shop-admin && npm install --prefix my-shop-shop
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix my-shop-api && npm install --prefix my-shop-admin && npm install --prefix my-shop-shop
scripts.env:setup: cp config/api.env my-shop-api/.env && cp config/admin.env my-shop-admin/.env && cp config/shop.env my-shop-shop/.env.local && echo '✅ Env files distributed!'
